SeaBIOS 1.16.3-2 (Debian)

Unmodified Debian SeaBIOS and VGA firmware binaries. The separate firmware is subject to LGPL/GPL and other notices described in its copyright file. Corresponding upstream source, Debian build configuration and patches are available here alongside the binaries.

  • Complete Debian copyright notice
  • LGPL version 3 and GPL version 3
  • LGPL version 2, which the copyright notice names for the ACPI table source src/acpi-dsdt.dsl
  • SeaBIOS 1.16.3 upstream source
  • Debian 1.16.3-2 build configuration and patches
